records.title: Complementary Roles of Activation and Parametric Memory in Few-Shot Learning
records.reason: This study compares activation memory (KV cache) with parametric memory in few-shot learning and tests when information stored in either form is effective. It is directly related to memory representation but does not propose a runtime memory/KV-cache reduction or serving optimization; evidence is explanatory and the practical inference-efficiency connection remains weak.

records.title: RAMP: Robust Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Edge CPU Vision Models
records.reason: Mixed-precision quantization evaluates vision models on edge CPUs, not LLM/VLM inference; no in-scope lineage link is recorded.
